entries.basis: JSTOR 27165940 (Israel Exploration Society) abstract: the article presents editions of five Mandaic bowl texts formerly in the Shlomo Moussaieff collection, with parallels, transliteration, translation and notes. The first-page preview (p. 106) shows the first edition headed 'Moussaieff 23' and states that Moussaieff 25 and 158 are not included.
